findings.description: The station scan inside the emulated Wi-Fi driver faults on the configured-reboot path (CPU cache error at PC 0xAFD6A25E, ieee80211_getmgtframe from ieee80211_send_probereq) with the same PC and cycle count across three builds, including after the APSTA removal and after moving esp_wifi_connect() to the net task. No product code is on that frame path.
findings.evidence: artifacts/061-functional_testing.json stability: mepc=0xAFD6A25E, #10 ieee80211_getmgtframe, #28 ieee80211_send_probereq, identical cycle count to reports 053 and 057; app_mqtt.cpp net_task only receives queued events.
findings.failureScenario: On the emulator, a commissioned panel that reboots with stored credentials dies in the Wi-Fi driver probe-request path about 1.7 s after reset, so the configured-reboot scenario cannot be exercised there; whether silicon behaves the same is unknown.
findings.suggestedChange: Decide on hardware: commission against a real AP and reboot twice; if it reproduces on silicon, examine the Wi-Fi scan/init configuration rather than app_mqtt sequencing.

findings.description: The new build reports nine -Wmissing-field-initializers warnings in app_mqtt.cpp (lines 305, 323, 473) from partially designated esp_timer_create_args_t initialisers; behaviour is correct because the omitted fields zero-initialise, but these are the first project-code warnings in this build.
findings.evidence: artifacts/063-firmware_compilation.json codeWarnings lines 305 and 323 in net_task and 473 in app_mqtt_ap_start; the initialisers read here are const esp_timer_create_args_t args = { .callback = ..., .name = ... };.
findings.failureScenario: A future genuine missing-initializer defect in this file becomes indistinguishable from these three known warnings, so the build warning channel stops being a signal.
findings.suggestedChange: Zero-initialise the struct first (esp_timer_create_args_t args = {}; then assign callback/name) in all three places.

findings.description: Standing owner-level deviations: the factory reset is a 10 s hold of the single front button rather than SET+MODE, and the voice vocabulary has no phrase for the spec example set the office to 21.
findings.evidence: app_logic.cpp:375-376 COMBO_ARM_MS on handles[0]; heating_voice.cpp k_variant_tenth 200, 215, 210 with 17 phrases registered per report 061.
findings.failureScenario: A user holding the front button for 10 s wipes the panel without a confirming combination, and saying the spec example sentence ends in Sorry, not understood.
findings.suggestedChange: Owner decision: restore the SET+MODE combination and add whole-number 21 variants, or record both as accepted deviations in the product description.

notes: STA_START is now answered only in STA/APSTA mode and a refused join is logged (net_task lines 279-293).
The Wi-Fi/IP event queue is created independently of the net task, so handlers are never registered with NULL (app_mqtt_init lines 761-777).
Commissioning moves the radio from AP-only to station mode in one step; the APSTA path is gone and the fresh boot logs wifi:mode : softAP alone.
The commissioned-reboot fault is unchanged across three builds and is attributed to the emulated Wi-Fi driver scan path; a hardware run is needed to close it.
mDNS task stack still cannot be configured (no mdns Kconfig in this build Kconfig set); mDNS is non-fatal so only the hostname is lost.

report.summary: The two product-side items from my review are fixed and verified in source (STA_START joins only in station mode with the result logged; the event queue no longer depends on the task); the remaining configured-reboot crash is a byte-identical Wi-Fi-driver scan fault on the emulator carried as a documented hardware question, plus new missing-field-initializer warnings in app_mqtt.cpp.
